item.name: Retrieves All Slot Configuration Ids & Names of an Organization

query.description: (Required) The unique identifier of the tracking target.
Filter on names when requesting slot names & IDs. Will perform '*query*' match pattern.
The 0-based index number of the page of [slot configuration](https://docs.coveo.com/en/o9b80563/glossary/recommendation-slot/) to retrieve.</br>**Minimum:** `0`</br>**Default:** `0`
The number of [slot configurations](https://docs.coveo.com/en/o9b80563/glossary/recommendation-slot/) to list per page.</br>**Minimum:** `1`</br>**Maximum:** `1000`</br>**Default:** `10`
